name: Penelope
source:
As quick to anger and physical confrontation as Nysa is, Penelope embodies a pure heart and unshakable kindness toward everyone she meets. She often ends up mediating arguments that Nysa starts and struggles with keeping her on task. If Nysa is the hammer in their work, Penelope is the planner.

[from [url=https://demondeals.org/characters]official site[/url]]
